archetypes.name: dyn-launcher-owner
archetypes.rationale: Verify stable PID propagation through the implement runner and tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the generated implement-run launcher and the updated tests around LARCH_CLAUDE_PID. Confirm the launcher defaults to the PID embedded in its filename, preserves an inherited value, and still exports IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR before execing larch-run.sh. Check that the shell harness assertion covers the stable-runner path without changing direct larch-run.sh behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
